notes.title: Shattered Memories DEMO 0.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Shattered Memories DEMO 0.5 Update is here! I made some small changes for the demo: 

- Change to the "A Hidden Place" level 
- Added running in the Exploration level 
- Easier Masahiko boss fight 
- Added boss hp bar



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610104/ab27b84e09b74fdc4ef2f765fd543b7de0483b90.png"]

That’s all! Have fun! Be sure to follow my social medias for updates!
